summary: Himalaya Shipping Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 14, 2026, announcing a new time charter agreement for the Mount Aconcagua for 16-18 months starting in the second half of July 2026. The vessel will earn an index-linked rate with a premium to the Baltic 5TC index and conversion rights to a fixed rate based on the FFA curve. This is a routine operational charter contract, not a special situation. No special-situation mechanics, advisor, or regulatory clock are involved. The filing is a foreign private issuer report with no merger, acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring elements.
